preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or marketingWallet address
Contract must have accumulated tax tokens (balanceOf(address(this)) > 0)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner or marketingWallet, call getAllTaxes() function to transfer all accumulated tax tokens to marketingWallet as ETH. The function swaps contract's token balance for ETH and sends it to marketingWallet without any limits. Ensure the contract has accumulated tax tokens from previous transactions first.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The BabyDogeCoin20 contract has an owner privilege abuse vulnerability. The owner (or marketingWallet) can call getAllTaxes() which swaps all tokens in the contract balance to ETH and sends it to the marketingWallet. Since the owner can set the marketingWallet to any address, they can drain all accumulated tax tokens (and any other tokens) from the contract.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the owner, set marketingWallet to attacker address (if not already), then call getAllTaxes() to drain all tokens from contract to ETH sent to attacker.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address from the contract. 2. Impersonate the owner using vm.prank(). 3. Check if marketingWallet is already attacker, if not, set it using setMarketingWallet(). 4. Call getAllTaxes() to swap all contract tokens to ETH and send to marketingWallet (attacker).
